notes.title: The rapidly expanding ARIDA backlands
notes.content:
Here comes the physical version of our Artbook! 😍📕

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/f204ac8cab2189428880cbf31a0d0117255eda5c.png
Published by Editora Europa, the launch establishes an unusual partnership between a Brazilian independent games company and a book publisher. Titled "The Art of ÁRIDA - Book I: Awakening", the physical ArtBook is available for pre-order, with release scheduled for 6/14. 

➡️ÁRIDA: Backlands Awakening - Book 1: Awakening - The Art of ARIDA

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/0ac616444e4e253a9a11ca7747daf3a8218edb4c.png
Those who visited Aoca's booth at the 2023 Brazil Game Show could interact with a prototype version of the book, and the public's reaction was the validation that Aoca needed to put the plan into practice. Aimed at collectors and people passionate about the series, the book contains many of the arts and concepts that brought ÁRIDA to life and details of Aoca's creative vision and behind-the-scenes! 

During the pre-sale, using the promotional code ARIDAPRE, it is possible to obtain an additional 15% discount on the Editora Europa website (Portuguese only)!

New printed materials from this partner are already in production, as well as the creation of other physical items so that the ÁRIDA hinterland continues its rapid expansion!

Meanwhile, the games in the series continue at full steam through the completion of the console versions of ÁRIDA 1 and the development of the long-awaited ÁRIDA 2!

notes.title: ÁRIDA: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
ÁRIDA gets a Definitive version that promises to please new and old fans of the series. 🌵

Improvements were implemented to expand and improve the experience, such as a map, new missions, new items, collectibles, and even new mechanics!

There are also three new game modes: “Adventurer” and “Survivor” and “Fearless”. In the first, dedicated to people who like to explore the scenarios and interact with the story, it is possible to have a more relaxing experience. Unlike the second, where the drought is more merciless and brings a more challenging experience. The third level is only recommended for more experienced profiles in survival games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/7e14b98687381ccdaf91a4e53584698011c7b64b.png

The updated version of ÁRIDA will be at a 50% discount for one week here on Steam.

Check out the full list of new features below:

 2 NEW Regions!

 NEW Balancing!

If you've already completed the game, try it again! You will not regret it! 😍

Come celebrate ÁRIDA’s growth with us!

notes.title: The faces of Cícera
notes.content:
Changes require transformations.
Or is it the other way around? 

Whoever played ARIDA: Backland's Awakening knows that Cícera faces a challenge of great proportions. 
A condition that questions the limits of what it means to be a child in the Brazilian backlands of the 19th century.

The new game in development, ÁRIDA: Rise of the Brave, will have some transformations as well. The central experience that defines the world of ÁRIDA remains, but we will present new ways to dive into this connection with the backlands and its stories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/9854d014e9b6f417efddd46f61df4fdc00bd870c.png

After all, we at Aoca are also constantly changing. Learning to leverage what we do best and adjusting where we need to grow. Very tuned with the feedbacks from people playing ARIDA around the world.

In this moment of global changes, we remain focused on creating this new game, with the conviction that it will be another beautiful path that we will create together!

Many people already have ÁRIDA: Rise of the Brave on their Steam wishlist. Go there and show us some love. 
This is the best way to put more and more people in contact with the new ÁRIDA! ❤ 🌵

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212030/ARIDA_Rise_of_the_Brave/

notes.title: News about ARIDA: Rise of the Brave
notes.content:
Survive the challenges of the backlands is the least you will need to do.

In ARIDA: Rise of the Brave, in addition to survive to overcome the drought and cross the backlands, you will need to find the clues that will take Cícera to Canudos. The place where dreams dwell, according to some.

There will be new and bigger areas to explore, other stories to discover and new connections that will be made by our brave protagonist.

The paths of Cícera will intersect with those of this formidable little goat named Titela, and from the difficulties of this journey, a strong bond of friendship will be born.  🐐 ❤

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/a7e635116ac30d811da93eed0dab8937ed152044.png

Titela is very cute! A goat still very young, a little flustered and quite loyal. Don’t judge his strength by his size.

He's beloved at Aoca and we believe you will fall in love too.  😍

🎮 Play ARIDA: Backland’s Awakening on Steam now:

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are still working to make the Árida experience better and better. That's why we released an update today to fix issues identified by you! We at Aoca thank everyone for the constant feedback we received!

Check out the full list of Patch 1.0.3


Optimization 
We made improvements in the game engine, resulting in a better framerate, especially for those who were struggling to play with better graphic qualities. If you still encounter problems running the game, please contact us via the Steam forum.


Sound Fixes
We balanced the volume of some sounds that were not consistent with the desired experience. And we add others. We also fixed some SFXs that didn't play when they should, and added more typical backland birds, which makes the ambience better!


Achievements
We fixed some Steam achievements. You will now receive the notifications correctly. Will you be able to complete them all?


Scene Improvements
We made adjustments to some transitions of the scenes. In this way, important moments of the game became visually smoother.


Languages
We reviewed the text in both available languages, and now everyone in the backlands speaks properly, in English and Portuguese!
If you still find something in the texts, feel free to contact us.

If you find any errors, report them through a Steam thread.
Tell us what you think about the news! 😊

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello, survivors


We are releasing this update to address some issues you have encountered, one of which involves the achievements that were not working correctly. Check it out all the changes below.


- Achievements -
 We corrected many issues related to the achievements, now they are properly registered on Steam. Your feedbacks have helped us a lot to solve this problem, thank you.

- Trap -
 Now the trap works properly. Just place it on the ground and wait a couple of minutes to catch something. [spoiler]But you won't get the vegan achievement if you eat any meat.[/spoiler]

- Bonfire -
Now the bonfire has a limited duration, as we intended. It will last for about 1 minute. You aways can build another one if you have the materials.

- Tooltip -
The tooltip panel is responsible for introducing game features, like new recipes. Now it's displayed properly on every resolution.

- Colectalbes -
There was one chest more than the intended, oops!

- Spoilers -

We’ve fixed an issue in the end game [spoiler]involving the banners[/spoiler].
Secret [spoiler]Bench[/spoiler]: In our last update, we fixed the interaction with this object. In this patch, we made more improvements. It is worth checking.

If you find any errors, report them through a Steam thread.

Tell us what you think of the update, we will answer your message on our social networks.

Discord
Facebook
Twitter

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33252395/9738ffa3308f0ecc6bc0921c6985614b634667db.png

Hey everyone. We present to you our first patch after the game launch!

The update contains some improvements that will upgrade the gameplay experience, especially in the mountain area, that seemed to be a major obstacle for you. Also, we made some balance changes and minor changes.

Let's go!
Game Balance
We increased the game difficulty, now you have to collect more food to stay healthy and you will get hungry and thirsty more often. It was too easy, right?


Reduced the benefits of many aliments (Eggs, Mandacaru, etc).
Increced the speed of reduction of the stats
Now the Death Valley is aridity level 3 (from 4).



Environment
We added more interaction objects, we hope you explore a lot. During your gameplay, some have complained about “invisible walls,” so we worked on the game's collisions responsible for these limits.


(Collider) Village area- Broken Bracket.
(Collider) Death Valley area - Dead Cow.
(Collider) Death Valley area - Invisible stones.
(Collider) Death Valley area - Fence Near the Cashew Tree.
(Collider) Farm Region - Bullock Cart.
(Terrain) Objects “buried” in certain parts of the map.
(Terrain) Objects “floating” in certain parts of the map.
(Terrain) Hole in the ground of the secret area.
(Terrain) Firmina's house area- Hole in the ground (Blue line).
(Terrain) Mountain area - Bannera.
(Terrain) Farm area - Woods floating in the corral.
(Models) Tiao doesn't disappear with distance anymore.
(Models) Mandacaru and other collectible foods disappear after being cut.
(Models) Trap's visual effect has been fixed.



Narrative
Dialogues play an important role within the game and we saw that you love playing the "voices" of each character. We reviewed some texts that were displayed wrong.


(Objects) - Fixed the dialog on some objects.
(Interface) - Now the credits are displayed also in English
(Interface) - Texts some texts appearing in the wrong place



Bugs and improvements
In the previous version, we saw several players encountering problems that discouraged you on your adventures. The bench at the end of the mountain was a major one, also the inventory that got stuck sometimes, not allowing the game to continue. We apologize for all the problems that have happened.


Revised disappearance time of collected objects.
Fixed the bug of the equipments stuck in Cicera's hand, after interaction with an object.
(Items) - Fixed a Confusing Notification 
(Feature) - All bench now work properly
(Feature) - Fixed the Inventory freezing when closed
(Feature) - Now the achievements don't disappear after game restart
(Feature) - Achievements are now accounted properly for by Steam



Audio
In the audio sector, some changes have arrived, one of them being the addition of a component responsible for the individual configuration of each object within the game.


(Feature) - Created audio tuning component
(Effect) - Individual audio adjustment of in-game objects
(Effect) - Fixed mountain ambient sound
(Effect) - Improved the ambient Sound of the Village
(Music) - Revised the audio from the last cutscene
(Extra) - Fixed the extra content audio after the end 



We are following your comments on social networks, especially here on Steam. Feedbacks will always be welcome and followed thoroughly.

After checking the changes in-game, send us a review on Steam!

Meet us at the Discord.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.9
notes.content:
In this version there are some improvements regarding performance. We inserted new dialogues, new mechanics and a new character, Father Olavo.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33252395/55171f1a8f39909f5a62be40af86d3d2eafb3dc6.png

Narrative and Characters
- All characters have new dialogues.
- Go to the Village and find a new character: Father Olavo.
- Almira moved out to a new place!
- Review of dialogues in English and Portuguese.
- Review of the quests descriptions in English and Portuguese.
- There is a prototype of the cinematics of the game.
- Sit on the bench to learn more stories from the backlands.


Scenario
- We have some new plants on the game.
- There's a new area: The Death Valley. But be careful, it's very dry there!
- Ground textures have been revised.
- Most items were repositioned.
- Some catingueiras were removed to improve orientation.


Art
- Cícera has new animations.
- All NPCs have new animations.
- New textures in some buildings.


Controls
- We are testing new values for the controls and camera.


Bug fixes and improvements
- Otimization of the inventory interface.
- We improved the interaction with some objects like the melocactus and the pumpkin.
- We improved the interaction with the waterhole.
- We polished some of the colliders.
- New achievements.
- Fixed a bug triggered on death.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.8
notes.content:
In this patch we improved the game performace, changed many dialogs and improved Almira storyline.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33252395/78f2f5819d43e704d24c72f6569f53b807a0280f.gif

Engine
-- We updated the game engine, improving performance in many computers. We also improved the lighting and shadow effects.

Story and Characters
- All characters have new dialogues!
- Firmina got a new goat! Find it at the way to the village.
- Almira is beautiful with her new clothes! She also has a new quest for you.
- We changed many texts for better understanding.

Environment
- There is an old farm by the road with many new objects to be discovered.
- The village is bigger and better (but still not accessible) than before.

Gameplay
- Be very cautious when exploring new areas, because hunger and thirst drain faster!
- Some areas are more arid than others. Pay attention to the HUD!
- New recipe: obtained in Almira's quest

Art and Design
- HUD improvements: new aridity indicator.
- Firmina and Almira have new animations.
- New textures in some buildings.

Controls
- We are testing some improvements for those who play with mouse and keyboard.

Bug fixes and improvements
- Now the signs show the text correctly.
- Corrected some of the descriptions.
- We improved the interaction range of ​​Cicera.
- We improved the collision with the waterhole. We also improved the collision with other problematic objects.
